Apart.description: The two resources should not work the same task.

weight.description: Required (an integer from 1 to 10000) when `hardness` is `soft`; must be omitted or null when `hardness` is `hard`.
weight.title: Weight

Apart.title: Apart

Assumption.description: Something the agent assumed and still needs to confirm.
Assumption.title: Assumption

AttributeBinding.description: Maps one CSV column to a typed attribute.

type.description: How every non-empty cell of the column is read: `str` as is; `int` a whole number (digits with an optional sign); `float` a number written with the file's `decimal` separator (with decimal `,` a `.` is rejected, never read as a thousands separator); `bool` one of `true`/`false`, `yes`/`no`, `1`/`0` in any letter case; `list` items split by `separator`. An empty cell means no value, except in a `list` column, where it is an empty list. A cell that cannot be read this way makes the model invalid.
type.title: Type

separator.description: Only for `type` `list`: the separator between the items of one cell. Default `;`.
separator.title: Separator

AttributeBinding.title: AttributeBinding

AttributeRef.description: A per-resource value: each resource's value of the named attribute (ADR-0006 §5).
AttributeRef.title: AttributeRef

Balance.description: Minimize max - min of a measure over scoped resources, counting scoped tasks (soft only).
Balance.title: Balance

Condition.description: One filter ``{attribute, op, value}``; the conditions of a scope are combined with AND.

attribute.description: `id`, or the name of an attribute bound under `data.resources.attributes` (in resource conditions) or `data.tasks.attributes` (in task conditions). Task conditions may also use the derived attributes of each task's local start: `weekday` (`mon`, `tue`, `wed`, `thu`, `fri`, `sat`, `sun`), `start_hour` (an integer 0–23), `duration_hours` (a number) and `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`). A condition on an attribute that a resource or task has no value for never holds, also with `ne` and `not_in`.
attribute.title: Attribute

value.description: A list for `in` and `not_in`; a single value (not a list) for `contains`, which holds when a `list` attribute contains it; a number or a string for `gte` and `lte`. Ids are written exactly as in the data: a condition on an id that does not exist selects nothing with `eq` and everything with `ne`.
value.title: Value

Condition.title: Condition

Coverage.description: Each in-scope task gets exactly ``demand`` resources (structural, hard only).
Coverage.title: Coverage

CsvDialect.description:
How a CSV file is written (ADR-0006 §5): delimiter, decimal separator and encoding.

The defaults read a plain UTF-8 file (BOM tolerated). ``decimal`` applies to ``float`` cells
only; Greek-locale Excel writes ``;``, ``,`` and Windows-1253.
CsvDialect.title: CsvDialect

DataBindings.description: Where the resources and tasks of a DM come from. Every `source` (here and in `unavailable` rules) names an existing CSV file in the model's folder, written in the declared `encoding` (a UTF-8 byte order mark is allowed only with `utf-8`); its first row is the header. Each column that a binding names must appear exactly once in the header (names and cells are trimmed); a row may not have more fields than the header. Cells of the `id`, `start`, `end`, `demand` and `resource_id` columns must not be empty.
DataBindings.title: DataBindings

Horizon.description: The planning period: ``start`` and ``end`` dates, both inclusive, at most 366 days. `end` is not before `start`.

start.description: A calendar date written as `YYYY-MM-DD`, from 1970-01-01 to 2999-12-31.
start.title: Start

end.description: A calendar date written as `YYYY-MM-DD`, from 1970-01-01 to 2999-12-31.
end.title: End

Horizon.title: Horizon

MaxConsecutiveDays.description: A resource works at most ``days`` consecutive days.

weight.description: Required (an integer from 1 to 10000) when `hardness` is `soft`; must be omitted or null when `hardness` is `hard`.
weight.title: Weight

MaxConsecutiveDays.title: MaxConsecutiveDays

MaxPerPeriod.description: Upper bound of a measure (count or hours) per resource per period.

weight.description: Required (an integer from 1 to 10000) when `hardness` is `soft`; must be omitted or null when `hardness` is `hard`.
weight.title: Weight

MaxPerPeriod.title: MaxPerPeriod

MinPerPeriod.description: Lower bound of a measure (count or hours) per resource per period.

weight.description: Required (an integer from 1 to 10000) when `hardness` is `soft`; must be omitted or null when `hardness` is `hard`.
weight.title: Weight

MinPerPeriod.title: MinPerPeriod

MinRest.description: The gap between consecutive tasks of a resource is at least ``hours``.

weight.description: Required (an integer from 1 to 10000) when `hardness` is `soft`; must be omitted or null when `hardness` is `hard`.
weight.title: Weight

MinRest.title: MinRest

hours.description: Hours, more than 0 and in whole minutes, e.g. `11` or `7.5` (not `7.501`).
hours.title: Hours

NoOverlap.description: A resource cannot work two time-overlapping tasks.

weight.description: Required (an integer from 1 to 10000) when `hardness` is `soft`; must be omitted or null when `hardness` is `hard`.
weight.title: Weight

NoOverlap.title: NoOverlap

limit.description: A number, or `{"attribute": …}` naming a resource attribute bound as `int` or `float` that every in-scope resource has. Limits are at least 0; with `measure` `count` whole numbers up to 100000, with `measure` `hours` up to 8784 in whole minutes.
limit.title: Limit

Preference.description: Scoped resources prefer or avoid scoped tasks (soft only).
Preference.title: Preference

Provenance.description: Where a rule came from: a user utterance, a data column, an assumption or a default.

quote.description: Required when `kind` is `utterance`: the words of the request the rule comes from.
quote.title: Quote

source.description: Required when `kind` is `data`: where in the data the rule comes from (free text, e.g. a file and a column).
source.title: Source

Provenance.title: Provenance

RequiresAttribute.description:
A resource may work a task only if its attribute matches the task's requirement.

Tasks without the task attribute, or with an empty list, are unrestricted.

weight.description: Required (an integer from 1 to 10000) when `hardness` is `soft`; must be omitted or null when `hardness` is `hard`.
weight.title: Weight

RequiresAttribute.title: RequiresAttribute

RequiresAttributeParams.description: `task_attribute` and `resource_attribute` name attributes bound in `data.tasks.attributes` and `data.resources.attributes`.
RequiresAttributeParams.title: RequiresAttributeParams

ResourceBinding.description: CSV binding for resources: id column plus typed attribute columns. `id` values are unique; the file has at least one resource.

source.description: A path relative to the model's folder, e.g. `staff.csv`; it may not leave that folder.
source.title: Source

attributes.description: Keys are attribute names: lower-case snake_case (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`), none of `id`, `start`, `end`, `demand`, `weekday`, `start_hour`, `duration_hours`, `date` (reserved). The CSV column itself may have any name (`column`).
attributes.title: Attributes

ResourceBinding.title: ResourceBinding

resource_ids.description: Two different resource ids from the data, written exactly as there.
resource_ids.title: Resource Ids

Scope.description: Which resources and tasks a rule applies to; an empty list means all.
Scope.title: Scope

Stability.description: Penalty per baseline assignment that changes (soft only).
Stability.title: Stability

baseline.description: Pairs of a task id and a resource id from the data, written exactly as there; each pair at most once.
baseline.title: Baseline

TaskBinding.description: CSV binding for tasks: id, start, end and demand columns plus typed attribute columns. `start` and `end` cells are ISO-8601 local date-times without a UTC offset, in whole minutes (e.g. `2026-11-02T07:00` or `2026-11-02 07:00`); `end` is after `start`, at most 24 h later, and every task starts inside the horizon. `demand` cells are whole numbers from 1 to 10000. `id` values are unique; the file has at least one task.

source.description: A path relative to the model's folder, e.g. `staff.csv`; it may not leave that folder.
source.title: Source

attributes.description: Keys are attribute names: lower-case snake_case (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`), none of `id`, `start`, `end`, `demand`, `weekday`, `start_hour`, `duration_hours`, `date` (reserved). The CSV column itself may have any name (`column`).
attributes.title: Attributes

TaskBinding.title: TaskBinding

TimeWindow.description: A local time interval ``[start, end)`` during which a resource is unavailable. `end` is after `start`; `resource_id` is a resource id from the data, written exactly as there.

start.description: Local date-time in the DM timezone, without UTC offset, from 1970-01-01T00:00 to 3000-01-01T00:00, e.g. 2026-11-02T07:00
start.title: Start

end.description: Local date-time in the DM timezone, without UTC offset, from 1970-01-01T00:00 to 3000-01-01T00:00, e.g. 2026-11-02T07:00
end.title: End

TimeWindow.title: TimeWindow

Together.description: The two resources should work the same in-scope tasks (soft only).
Together.title: Together

Unavailable.description: A resource cannot work tasks that overlap its unavailability windows.

weight.description: Required (an integer from 1 to 10000) when `hardness` is `soft`; must be omitted or null when `hardness` is `hard`.
weight.title: Weight

Unavailable.title: Unavailable

Vocabulary.description: Domain words for display only, e.g. ``{"resource": "employee", "task": "shift"}``.
Vocabulary.title: Vocabulary

WindowsBinding.description: CSV binding for unavailability windows (one row per window). `start` and `end` cells as in the tasks file; `resource_id` cells are resource ids from the data, written exactly as there.

source.description: A path relative to the model's folder, e.g. `staff.csv`; it may not leave that folder.
source.title: Source

WindowsBinding.title: WindowsBinding

description: A typed, solver-agnostic description of an assignment decision problem (DM 0.2). Every integer (`type` `integer`) is written as plain digits: `5`, not `5.0` or `5e0`.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone key exactly as the tz database writes it (case-sensitive), e.g. `Europe/Athens`. Every local date-time of the model and of its data files is in this zone; a local time skipped by a daylight-saving change is invalid.
timezone.title: Timezone

constraints.description: The rules of the model. Exactly one constraint has `template` `coverage`. Every constraint `id` is unique within the model.
constraints.title: Constraints

assumptions.description: Every assumption `id` is unique within the model.
assumptions.title: Assumptions
